page.overview:
What is Mendo?

is an endoskeleton exclusive to FNaF World. It is the owner of Mendo's Endo-Upgrades, a store located in Fazbear Hills that sells items which raise the player's party defense.

Mendo's appearance appears to be a blue recoloring of Endo-01 but has some notable differences. It has bigger arms, a yellow/orange antennae, a green button on its chest, and black eyes with yellow pupils.
